Asset type: one complete photorealistic baseball batter animation sprite, 1024 x 1536 portrait PNG with genuine transparent alpha.
The input image is the ONLY edit target, not a loose style reference. Transparent cutout only. No ground plane, scenery, shadow, colored backdrop, black backdrop, glow, vignette, labels, lettering, jersey number, sponsor, logo or watermark. One complete continuous person only, not a collage or sheet. No illustration, cartoon, mannequin, puppet, reversed joints, extra limbs, duplicated bat or implausible anatomy.
Pose: LEFT-HANDED FOLLOW-THROUGH finish. Keep the input's exact rotated back and blank jersey-number panel, shoulders and torso, face direction, lifted arms, hands/grip and upward-right wooden bat unchanged.

Bring the trailing toe inward to x760–785 at the SAME y1513, retaining original raised heel/toe-pivot orientation. These are inward foot moves of roughly 85–95px each. Preserve relative shoe sizes and physically coherent calves/ankles.
